newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian stock markets closed for religious holiday.
newsitem.headline: Indian stock markets closed for religious holiday.

text.p: Indian stock markets are closed for a religious holiday on Monday, brokers said.
The markets are expected to stabilise this week as fiscal year-end dampeners give way to renewed hope, but fresh demand will be slow, dealers said.
The Bombay Stock Exchange's top-30 share index finished 15.11 points, or 0.40 percent, off at 3,730.20 last week after dipping to 3,689.07.
